Question: A customer asks to change the order after sign-off
Recommended solution: 1. Thank them and say you will price it. 2. Write the change and its price on the change form. 3. Do no work until the form is signed.
Context: Any job with a signed quote. Not for changes under one hour of work.
Keywords: change request; variation; extra work; scope change

Question: A supplier delivers fewer items than ordered
Recommended solution: 1. Photograph the delivery and the note on arrival. 2. Email the supplier the same day. 3. Claim the credit within 7 days.

Question: A customer wants a discount
Recommended solution: Offer to reduce the scope first. A price reduction needs the owner's approval.
Context: Quotes over 5,000. Under that, hold the price.
